Resolves #20188

Moves `role: 'grid'`, `'aria-colcount'`, and `'aria-rowcount'` from `.neo-grid-container`'s outer node onto an inner `ariaWrapper` (`Neo.container.Base`) item wrapping `headerWrapper` and `view` (`src/grid/Container.mjs`), leaving `searchToolbar` as a sibling outside the ARIA `grid` subtree while keeping `Neo.grid.Container#items` and `getVdomItemsRoot().cn` index-aligned across `insert()`, `removeAt()`, and `add()`/`remove()`. This returns one wrapper element to the grid container that was flattened on 2026-04-02 (`b0b7faf8-1747-44e6-8e69-209ccba9eadc`), as a real container item for WAI-ARIA ownership. In `Neo.grid.header.Button#wrapColumnMenuRoot`, moves `role: 'columnheader'`, `'aria-colindex'`, `'aria-description'`, and `'aria-sort'` from the inner sort `<button>` onto the `.neo-grid-menu-wrapper` `<div>` (with `'aria-labelledby': this.id`), keeping both the sort button and the column menu trigger inside a single `columnheader` across initial construction, runtime `columnMenu` wrapping, sorting, filtering, and column index updates.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; baseline unit, component, and e2e grid suites ran (`change-class: restoration`).

Evidence: L4 (live Chromium CDP `Accessibility.getFullAXTree` e2e + component + unit suites) → L4 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3).

| AC-1 | `test/playwright/e2e/grid/IssuesShowcase.spec.mjs` (`strayControls` is `[]` inside the `grid` AX subtree; `controlsOf(toolbarSibling)` verifies `Search records`, `Grid columns`, and `Match case` on the sibling node) + `test/playwright/unit/grid/AriaRegions.spec.mjs` (including `insert`/`removeAt` container index alignment) |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/e2e/grid/IssuesShowcase.spec.mjs` (`columnMenus` verifies `Filter Type`, `Filter Area`, `Filter Author`, `Filter State` inside their `columnheader` AX nodes; `#19913` `aria-sort` e2e verifies wrapped `State` header alongside unwrapped headers) + `test/playwright/unit/grid/HeaderButtonSortable.spec.mjs` + `test/playwright/unit/grid/HeaderMenu.spec.mjs` |
| AC-3 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/` (353 passed), `test/playwright/component/grid/HeaderMenuShape.spec.mjs` (8 passed), `test/playwright/e2e/grid/IssuesShowcase.spec.mjs` (16 passed), `test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderCellRectSync.spec.mjs` (1 passed), `test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderResizeRectSync.spec.mjs` (6 passed), `test/playwright/e2e/grid/SearchToolbarNL.spec.mjs` (3 passed) |

- Updates `src/selection/grid/CellModel.mjs` (`onNavKeyColumn`) and `src/selection/grid/ColumnModel.mjs` (`onNavKeyColumn`) to address `view.gridContainer.scrollByColumns(...)` instead of `view.parent.scrollByColumns(...)`, and updates `test/playwright/unit/grid/SearchToolbar.spec.mjs` for `items[0]` being `ariaWrapper` when `searchToolbar` is absent.
